'''Snare''' is a level 50 [[Magic]] [[spell]]. Casting Snare on an opponent will prevent it from moving for 16 [[ticks]] (9.6 seconds). When used on a player and the snare is about to wear off, the snared player will receive this message in their chatbox: {{mes|The holding effect is beginning to fade.|color=red}} Players can increase the binding duration by equipping [[swampbark armour]]; the [[Swampbark helm|helm]], [[Swampbark body|body]], and [[Swampbark legs|legs]] will increase the duration by 2 [[ticks]] (1.2 seconds) each, up to a maximum of 22 [[ticks]] (13.2 seconds).

Snare gives 61 Magic [[experience]] if it successfully hits the target, or 60 experience if it [[splash]]es.

==Trivia==
* '''Snare''' behaviour was modified without a patch note in an update. Unlike [[Bind]] and similarly to [[ice spells]] like [[Ice Barrage]], this spell could have been cast on a target that was immune to its binding effect (likely due to the minor damage that it can inflict). Currently, attempting to cast the spell on an immobilized target results in the message {{mes|Your target is already held by a magical force.}}, while trying to cast the spell on a target during the grace period after the end of the binding effect results in the message {{mes|The target is currently immune to that spell.}}
